author: martinamalberti
body:
#### PR description:
This PR updates the BTL readout map (detector  electronics mapping), based on the link mapping discussed at the
[MTD DAQ meeting of 10/09/2026](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1728068/contributions/7267163/attachments/3340485/5987766/LinkMapping_DAQmeeting_20260910.pdf), and adds a dense index of the BTL electronics channels, which will later be used by the BTL unpacker and to store and access the per-channel calibrations.

Main changes:

- Mapping update (`EventFilter/MTDRawToDigi`):
  - S-link / FED assignment: each tray is read out by 2 S-links (RUs 0-2 and RUs 3-5), numbered consecutively along the trays
  - HS-link id within the Serenity: `RU + 6  (tray % 6)`, in [0, 36). The previous temporary HS-link mapping based on the optical Tx channels (and the lpGBT id argument) is removed.

- Electronics id and dense indexing (`CondFormats/MTDObjects`):
   - `BTLElectronicsSpecs.h` moved from `EventFilter/MTDRawToDigi/interface` to `CondFormats/MTDObjects/interface`, with the DAQ constants (number of FEDs, HS-links per FED/Serenity, e-links per HS-link, channels per e-link) and the table of TOFHIR channel partners.
   - `BTLElectronicsId` bit layout updated: hsLinkId on 6 bits (0-35), fedId starting at bit 16; new methods `denseChannelIndex()` and `isValid()` added.
  - New header `BTLElectronicsIndexing.h` with `constexpr` functions usable on host and in alpaka kernels
  - `BTLReadoutMap`: new methods `getListOfDetIds()` and `checkDenseChannelIndex()`, which checks that the dense indexes of all the channels in the map are 0..n-1 and ordered consistently with the electronics rawIds.


#### PR validation:
-  `TestBTLReadoutMap` (`EventFilter/MTDRawToDigi/test/testBTLReadoutMap_cfg.py`): dense channel index check passed for all the 331776 channels.
-  runTheMatrix workflow 38434.0 (TTbar, Run4 D128, no PU), 10 events: all steps run successfully (the BTL digitizer uses `BTLReadoutMap`).
- No change in the physics output as only the FED/HS-link assignment changes, the TOFHIR channel ids are unchanged.


#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

This is not a backport.
title: [MTD] Update of the BTL readout map
